text: Seabrook Town played a great game and won 4-2 against Harbour City. At first, Harbour City scored two goals, one by Elias Okafor and another by Marek Barros [#905] [#975]. But after that, Seabrook Town worked really hard and shot a lot more, making 22 shots in total! Kian Romano was a star player who scored two exciting goals at the end of the match to make the score 4-2 [#1882] [#1906]. Marek Barros helped his team a lot too, with a great goal, two assists, and many tackles, earning him the player of the match award. The game was full of action with fast passes and clever strategies. Imagine a big, colorful football flying into the net as Kian Romano’s last goal made Seabrook Town the winners!

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for kid audience in en

- Harbour City utilized a patient short passing style in a 4-2-3-1 formation, building up their first goal with 17 passes over nearly a minute, involving multiple players and culminating in a through ball assist from Marek Barros to Elias Okafor, who finished from 11.7 meters [904,905].
- Marek Barros scored the second Harbour City goal from a corner situation, showcasing their ability to capitalize quickly on set-piece opportunities; Barros provided a cross after limited build-up, reflecting a momentary shift from patient possession to a more direct approach from a dead-ball scenario [973,975].
- Seabrook Town, set in a 3-4-3 formation favoring wide, crossing play, compensated for an initial lower xG and no first-half goals by increasing pressing intensity and directness in the second half, as evidenced by their tactical change at 65' to press higher and play more direct, which improved their attacking threat [1361].
- Seabrook Town's goals often sprang from quick regains and direct counter-attacks involving few passes, such as Tariq Marlowe’s solo goal following a regain, and the late Kian Romano goals from quick through balls and short passes, highlighting their effective use of wide areas and direct transitions within their 3-4-3 wide formation [1103,1104; 1881,1882; 1905,1906].

- Seabrook Town won the match 4-2 despite trailing 2-0 after goals by Elias Okafor (xG 0.148) and Marek Barros (xG 0.029) for Harbour City [#905, #975].
- Seabrook Town dominated the match in shots (22 vs 10) and expected goals (3.53 vs 1.26), reflecting their offensive effectiveness [team_stats].
- Kian Romano scored two late goals with very high xG values, 0.554 and 0.994, turning the game around in stoppage time [#1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros was influential with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a perfect 10.0 rating, the player of the match [player_of_the_match].
- Harbour City received a red card to Joon Whitfield at 43', likely impacting their ability to hold the lead [#871].
